patch_list: Bypass License Check & Auto-Restore Save Data
Bypasses pairip license check and automatically restores backup save data from external storage.
Disable Interstitial, App Open & Banner Ads
Bypasses interstitial, app-open and banner ads by intercepting readiness and show calls.
Sets extractNativeLibs to true and adds metadata to disable Firebase/Google analytics.
Bypasses Google Play billing dialog and immediately simulates a successful purchase.
Bypasses rewarded video ads and immediately grants the reward.
